mapper.insert: insert into product(category_id, name, price, stock, sales, is_on_sale, image_url, detail_html, params_text) values(#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{sales}, #{isOnSale}, #{imageUrl}, #{detailHtml}, #{paramsText})
mapper.update: update product set stock = stock - #{quantity} where id = #{id} and stock >= #{quantity}
update product set is_on_sale=0, stock=0 where id=#{id}
